subject: Future Tech
title: Printing with Earth and Recycled Materials
description: Learn Printing with Earth and Recycled Materials in one minute.

hook.text: What if homes were printed from the dirt beneath your feet?

buildup.text: Their TECLA prototype is a dome-shaped dwelling printed from raw earth.

discovery.text: Earth-based printing produces near-zero carbon emissions.

twist.text: Recycled plastic is another printable material.

climax.text: Combining local materials with robotic printing could create sustainable housing that's cheap, fast, and green.

punchline.text: The best building material might already be under your feet.

quiz.question: What materials does WASP use to 3D-print homes?
options: Local clay, straw, and rice husks
